title: Numeric Source Registry and Normalization
negative_results: Leading zeros are never discarded: '007' stays three characters, the leading-zero count is recorded, and the integer value sits beside the exact original.
A unitless value stays unitless: normalization never fills a unit, and forcing a unit onto a NO_UNIT value is refused (refuse_forced_interpretation).
The raw string is immutable: the RawVector is frozen and its raw_hash binds the original.
No geographic promotion: a registered value must be SOURCE_CLAIM or MATHEMATICAL_TRANSLATION; a CALIBRATED_MAPPING (or any geographic) class is refused.
Malformed input fails safely: empty values and duplicate ids are refused; normalization is deterministic.

claims.statement: Raw numeric vectors, dial values, grouped numbers, timestamps, and no-unit values register with the exact original string preserved beside a non-coercive normalized parse.
A close arithmetic re-expression of a source value asserts no unit the source did not state and no geographic location.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
